name: com.nkstudio.uitk-navigation
description:
Graph-authored navigation, animated views, and panel-local popup stacks for Unity UI Toolkit.

▪ Graph Toolkit authoring compiled from .uinavgraph into a runtime navigation asset
▪ NavElement, NavButton, and NavToggle UXML elements with a project-wide Key Catalog
▪ LitMotion-backed Move / Rotate / Scale / Fade Show and Hide transitions
▪ Back / Forward history, timed and toggle routes, and scene or application action nodes
▪ LIFO popup stack with data binding, async results, focus restoration, and per-template Back behavior

Requires LitMotion (com.annulusgames.lit-motion) and ZLinq (com.cysharp.zlinq). Install both separately from their Git URLs before installing this package.
